description: This PHP script handles sending support notification emails for upcoming support end dates, including notifications one week and one month in advance, using email templates and logging.

methods.name: showstatus
methods.description: Displays the status of email sending operation.

methods.name: getcontent_month
methods.description: Retrieves email subject and body content for monthly notifications, merging contact and user data.

methods.name: getcontent_week
methods.description: Retrieves email subject and body content for weekly notifications, merging contact and user data.
